item.text: The failure path runs through `ListRecord.from_input()`: it reads combined request parameters with `web.input()` and passes them to `unflatten()`. I also found that `unflatten()` keeps the first value assigned to a simple key. I’ll isolate POST body parsing and update that assignment behavior.
